name: dynamo.describe_graph
description: Reads a Dynamo graph (.dyn file) and returns its inputs and outputs without executing it. Call this *before* dynamo.run_graph if you don't already know the input node names — the result tells you exactly what keys to put in `run_graph`'s `inputs` dict and what types they expect. Pure metadata: does not need a Revit document open and has no side effects.

graph_path.description: Absolute path to the Dynamo graph file (.dyn).

inputs.description: Nodes flagged 'Is Input' in Dynamo. Use the `name` field as the key when calling dynamo.run_graph.

type.description: Normalised: string, integer, number, boolean, or unknown.

default.description: The value last saved in the graph (best treated as a hint, not a default to reuse blindly).

outputs.description: Nodes flagged 'Is Output' in Dynamo. Their values come back in the `outputs` dict of dynamo.run_graph's result.

examples.description: Discover what a graph takes before running it
